propositions: Pass-1 during execution-phase re-review flags plan-vs-code discrepancies as violations when the code state already matches the plan's directed end state, causing false positives that block correct completed tickets from closing.
A new plan-review-only binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` enables Pass-2 to veto such findings only when `execution_review=True` and the answer is a definite yes.

The veto is cohort-restricted to `registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED` (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) and enforced deterministically in orchestrator via `_restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded`, preventing tool-less verifiers from firing it.
The `execution_review` kwarg flows from orchestrator into the kernel's `pass3_decide` and `pass3_over_findings`, defaulting False to preserve planning-phase behavior.
Planning-phase reviews and code-review calls remain byte-unchanged; only execution-phase reviews with definite yes answers on grounded findings trigger the veto.
